description: This PHP class 'PendingLeaveRequestSummary' is part of the OrangeHRM project under the Dashboard ActionSummary DTO for pending leave requests. It encapsulates logic to count pending leave requests for given employee numbers, utilizing traits and services to interact with leave request data.

classes.name: PendingLeaveRequestSummary
classes.description: A DTO class implementing ActionSummary, designed to summarize pending leave requests that require approval, filtered by employee numbers, leveraging leave request services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the search filter parameters with employee numbers, setting the status to pending approval and including current employees only.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID identifier for this summary, hardcoded as 1.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the group, 'Leave Requests To Approve'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of pending leave requests matching the search filter parameters.
